kjv: a nation scattered and peeled ... a nation meted out and trodden down
mine: a nation tall and smooth ... a nation mighty and conquering
note: Hebrew memushshak umorat means "drawn out (tall) and polished (smooth-skinned)", describing the Cushites (cf. Herodotus 3.20); qaw-qaw umebusah is obscure, probably "of strength and trampling". The KJV makes the conquerors into victims. Context: tall and smooth-skinned (medium confidence). The oracle addresses Cush (18:1); Herodotus describes the Ethiopians as the tallest and handsomest of peoples.
